scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "pnpm --dir backend start:dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:e2e
